2. The plaintiff-petitioners case, in brief is that the petitioners, as plaintiffs, instituted Title Suit No. 60 of 1976 in the first Court of Munsif, Sadar, Dinajpur for declaration of their title to 10.10 acres of the suit land. The suit was renumbered as Title Suit No. 7 of 1985 in the Court of Munsif, Chirir Bandar. The defendant No. 30, herein opposite party No. 1, has been contesting the suit by submitting written statement on 19-8-1977 (Annexure-A) and other defendant Nos. 1, 3, 5, 6 and 7 and defendant Nos. 14/21, 23/24 and 26/28 submitted written statements but until now did not appear to contest the suit. The defendant No. 30 claimed .50 decimals of land out of the suit land by purchase dated 27-6-1975. The plaintiffs claimed their title to the suit land by pattan. But it is evident from the written statement of the defendant No. 30 (Annexure-A) that he had not given specific, not even by necessary implication denial of plaintiffs' case of pattan and possession of the suit lands and material allegations of the facts in the plaint which is mandatory under rule 3 of Order VIII of the Code of Civil Procedure and, as such, under rule 5 of the Order VIII of the Code every allegation of fact in the plaint and the plaintiffs' case shall be taken to be admitted by defendant No. 30. Plaintiffs' witnesses were examined and cross-examined in full on 14- 12-1985. Thereafter on 17-6-2001 defendant No. 30 filed a petition for substitution of the heirs of non- contesting defendant No. 3. The defendant No. 30 further submitted an additional written statement (Annexure-C) apparently after about 24 years of his first written statement dated 19-8-1977 accompanied by an application (Annexure-D) for acceptance of the additional written statement wherein he denied for the first time the plaintiffs case which he did not deny in his earlier written statement (Annexure-A). The learned Court below passed the impugned order dated 2-7-2001 allowing the aforesaid prayer dated 17-6-2001 of the defendant No. 30 for substitution of the heirs of non- contesting defendant No.3 and accepted the additional written statement of the defendant No. 30 dated 17-6-2001. 

 13. Here in this case the suit was instituted in the year 1976 and the defendant No. 30 filed written statement in the suit on 19-8-1977 (Annexure-A). Then, after a long lapse of about 24 years the defendant No. 30 filed an additional written statement (Annexure-C) on 17-6-2001 along with a petition (Annexure-D) for its acceptance. In the said additional written statement (Annexure-C) the defendant No. 30 has denied the plaintiffs' case of pattan and thereby acquiring title to the suit land and possession thereof which he has not specifically denied in his earlier written statement (Annexure-A) as required under rule 3 of Order VIII of the Code of Civil Procedure.
